Complete Restoration

Why Full Mouth Implants Transform Lives

Full arch implants replace all missing or failing teeth with a permanent, fixed solution. No more dentures, no adhesives, no slipping — just confident eating, speaking, and smiling.

Permanent Fixed Solution

Unlike dentures, full arch implants are screwed directly into your jawbone. They never come out, never slip, and require no special cleaning routines. Brush and floss just like natural teeth.

Immediate Functionality

Walk out with temporary teeth the same day as surgery. You can eat soft foods immediately and resume normal chewing within 2–3 weeks. Final zirconia bridge placed after 3–6 months of healing.

Cost-Effective at Scale

Replacing 10–14 teeth individually would cost £15,000–25,000 in the UK. Full arch restoration with 4–6 implants costs £4,500–6,500 in Istanbul — a 70% saving with identical clinical outcomes.

Preserves Jawbone

Dental implants stimulate bone just like natural tooth roots, preventing the bone loss and facial collapse that occurs with dentures. Your facial structure remains youthful and stable long-term.

Natural Aesthetics

Final prostheses are crafted from layered zirconia — mimicking natural tooth translucency, color, and texture. Gum-colored acrylic recreates natural tissue. Results are indistinguishable from real teeth.

Proven Longevity

All-on-4/6 implants have 95%+ survival rates at 10 years. With proper hygiene and regular check-ups, your implants can last a lifetime. The prosthetic bridge may need replacement after 15–20 years due to wear.

Treatment Anatomy

How All-on-4/6 Works

Full arch restoration uses strategically angled implants to maximize bone contact and eliminate the need for bone grafting in most cases.

1

Anterior Implants

Placed vertically in the front of the jaw where bone is naturally denser

2

Angled Posterior

Tilted 30–45° to avoid sinuses and nerves while maximizing bone contact

3

Full Arch Bridge

Single prosthesis with 10–14 teeth, screwed onto implants for permanent fixation

4

No Bone Graft

Strategic angulation eliminates grafting in 90% of cases — faster healing

Treatment Journey

Your Full Mouth Implant Procedure

From consultation to final prosthesis — the entire journey typically requires two visits to Istanbul over 5–6 months.

1
Pre-Arrival

Digital Planning

Before you travel, VeaHealth coordinates a full diagnostic workup — panoramic X-rays, 3D CBCT scan, and digital treatment planning. Your surgeon designs implant placement virtually to ensure optimal positioning.

  • Medical history & consultation via video
  • Digital X-rays & CBCT scan uploaded
  • 3D surgical guide designed
  • Final treatment plan & quote confirmed
  • Travel & accommodation arranged
2
Day 1–2 — Istanbul

Surgery & Temporary Teeth

Under IV sedation or general anesthesia, 4–6 implants are placed per arch. Any failing teeth are extracted. Temporary acrylic teeth are attached the same day — you walk out with a full smile.

  • IV sedation or general anesthesia
  • Tooth extractions (if needed)
  • 4–6 implants placed per arch
  • Immediate temporary prosthesis attached
  • Post-op instructions & medications
3
Day 3–7 — Istanbul

Healing & Adjustments

You remain in Istanbul for 5–7 days for daily check-ups. Swelling peaks at 48 hours. Your surgeon adjusts the temporary teeth for comfort and verifies healing is on track before you return home.

  • Daily wound inspection
  • Suture removal (day 7–10)
  • Temporary teeth bite adjustment
  • Pain management monitored
  • Soft diet guidance provided
4
Month 1–4

Osseointegration

Implants fuse with your jawbone over 3–6 months. You wear temporary teeth during this period and follow a gradual diet progression. VeaHealth monitors your healing remotely via photos and video calls.

  • Bone integration occurs naturally
  • Temporary teeth remain in place
  • Gradual return to normal diet
  • Remote check-ins every 2 weeks
  • No travel required during healing
5
Month 4–6 — Return Visit

Final Prosthesis Placement

You return to Istanbul for 3–5 days. The temporary bridge is removed and digital impressions are taken. Your final zirconia prosthesis is fabricated, tested, and permanently attached.

  • Temporary prosthesis removed
  • Digital impressions & bite registration
  • Final zirconia bridge crafted (2–3 days)
  • Try-in with shade and bite verification
  • Permanent attachment & warranty docs

Patient Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Is full mouth implant surgery painful?

The procedure is performed under IV sedation or general anesthesia — you feel nothing during surgery. Post-op discomfort (swelling, soreness) peaks at 48 hours and is managed with prescribed pain medication and cold compresses. Most patients describe it as less painful than a single tooth extraction.

How long do full mouth dental implants last?

The titanium implants can last a lifetime with proper care — studies confirm 95%+ survival at 10 years and 20+ year longevity is common. The zirconia prosthesis may need replacement after 15–20 years due to wear. Biannual professional cleanings are essential for long-term success.

Can I eat normally with full arch implants?

Yes. After the initial healing period (3–6 months), you can eat all foods without restriction — including steak, nuts, apples, and corn on the cob. Chewing power is restored to 90–95% of natural teeth. No more dietary limitations like with dentures.

What if I don’t have enough bone?

The All-on-4/6 technique is specifically designed for patients with bone loss. Angled posterior implants avoid areas of deficiency and maximize contact with available bone. In 90% of cases, no bone grafting is needed. If grafting is required, VeaHealth identifies this during pre-treatment planning.

How many trips to Istanbul are required?

Two visits: the first for surgery and temporary teeth (7 days), and a second visit 4–6 months later for the final prosthesis (3–5 days). The healing phase in between is managed remotely by VeaHealth with no travel required.

Is the warranty valid internationally?

Yes. VeaHealth’s lifetime warranty on implants and 3-year warranty on prosthetics are valid worldwide. If a warranty issue arises after you return home, VeaHealth coordinates resolution remotely or via a local affiliated clinic in your country.

What implant brand will be used?

VeaHealth exclusively uses Straumann and Nobel Biocare implants — the two most researched and validated brands globally. The specific brand, model, and serial numbers are documented in your treatment file and provided at completion. This is a contractual guarantee.

Can smokers receive full mouth implants?

Smokers can receive implants, but tobacco significantly reduces success rates by impairing healing and osseointegration. VeaHealth strongly recommends stopping smoking at least 4–6 weeks before and 3–6 months after surgery. Compliance with smoking cessation measurably improves outcomes.
